ai.title: Rename pendingEntity to entityBuffer in Saxy
ai.summary: Internal refactor of Saxy XML parser renames _pendingEntity to _entityBuffer for clarity. parseEntities gains explicit string return type. Removes conditional check for pending entity when emitting buffered text at chunk end. Affects common/src/util/saxy.ts.

eli5.text: The software that reads through chunks of text data now keeps better track of incomplete pieces by storing them in a clearer labeled spot, so when one chunk ends and the next begins, it knows exactly what was left over to finish first. This is the kind of behind-the-scenes cleanup that makes the system run more smoothly and readably, but you wouldn't see or feel any difference in how it works today.

ai.title: experimental costMode sets thinkingBudget to 0
ai.summary: In `backend/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts`, the `getAgentStream` logic now sets `thinkingBudget` to 0 when `costMode` is 'experimental', alongside 'normal' and 'max'. Previously, 'experimental' mode left `thinkingBudget` undefined. This change ensures consistent budget handling for experimental cost modes within the agent stream.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to run in an experimental cost-saving mode, it will now skip the thinking step and respond without any internal reasoning tokens, whereas before it would attempt to think through the problem in some cases. You would notice this as faster, more direct replies whenever the experimental setting is active. This only applies to the experimental mode; the normal and most expensive cost settings behave exactly as they did before.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.274
ai.summary: Updated `npm-app/package.json` version from 1.0.270 to 1.0.274. Internal release increment.

eli5.text: If you downloaded or updated the assistant app today, the version number on your device would now read one step higher than before, which is how the software knows it's running the latest packaged build. The bump itself is just an internal label change, but this build also ships with several smaller behavioral adjustments: experimental mode now limits the model's advance thinking to keep responses cheaper, and the experimental prompt path now correctly hides advanced tool-building instructions and fixes how it assembles instructions. A couple of behind-the-scenes corrections also landed, like the assistant now refusing to pass specially formatted characters into tool calls and fixing how it ignores files in nested project folders. None of this changes the app's look or menus; it just keeps the install current and steadies a few internal pathways.

ai.title: Unify fetch timeouts via withTimeout util
ai.summary: Refactored timeout handling in `context7-api.ts` and `ai-sdk.ts` to use shared `withTimeout` utility instead of inline `Promise.race`. Added optional `timeout` parameter to `promptAiSdkStructured` in `ai-sdk.ts`. Improved default timeout message in `common/src/util/promise.ts` to include duration. Updated error logging in `get-documentation-for-query.ts` for clarity.

eli5.text: The app now uses a single, consistent way to give up on a task (like calling an AI or loading documentation) if it takes too long, instead of each part of the app reinventing its own timeout logic. Behind the scenes, the code was cleaned up so one shared timer function is reused everywhere it was needed, and one of the AI-calling tools gained an optional setting so callers can pick how long to wait. If you don't see that feature used anywhere yet, nothing you experience changes day to day.

ai.title: Strengthen pre-turn-end validation prompts
ai.summary: Backend prompts now mandate completion of all subgoals before ending turn. The conditional logic restricting validation instructions to specific cost modes was removed, applying the requirement to check file changes, tests, and lint errors universally. Agent instructions were updated to emphasize not ending turn while work remains and to clarify the end_turn tool usage.

eli5.text: When you ask the coding assistant to do a task, it now has to finish every step and check its work before handing control back to you. Previously, those final checks were only required in certain situations; now they apply every time, so the assistant can no longer stop early and leave errors, failed tests, or unfinished changes behind.

ai.title: Add awaittoolresults tool for agent feedback
ai.summary: Introduced `await_tool_results` to allow agents to pause and check tool outputs before continuing. Updated `main-prompt.ts` and `agent-instructions.md` to mandate this tool usage before `end_turn` to verify state. Registered tool in `backend/src/tools.ts` and `common/src/constants/tools.ts` with no parameters. Added handler and renderer in `npm-app` to process the pause silently.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to do a multi-step task, it now has a way to pause and double-check that each step actually worked before moving on or finishing. Instead of just charging ahead and wrapping up, the assistant can stop to review what happened so far, confirm files were saved correctly and tests pass, and only then continue, which helps catch mistakes earlier. Right now, this mainly affects you in that the assistant follows a built-in checklist before ending a turn, so fewer half-finished or broken changes slip through.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.275
ai.summary: Freebuff CLI package version updated from 1.0.274 to 1.0.275. Change applies to npm-app/package.json. No functional code or dependency changes included in this release.

eli5.text: If you use the assistant today, you are now on the version that includes a new behind-the-scenes tool letting agents pause and check their work before continuing, plus stricter checks that prevent premature turn endings. The visible change is the new pause-and-review capability; the rest are reliability improvements. This release is live now.

ai.title: Refine agent prompts and model mappings
ai.summary: Updated main prompt instructions to enforce `end_turn` usage after verification via `run_terminal_command` or `await_tool_results`. Adjusted `thinkingBudget` to 0 in `prompt-agent-stream.ts` and refined tool descriptions in `tools.ts`. Modified model mappings in `common/src/constants.ts` for agent operations, switching `normal`/`max` modes to `models.sonnet` and `experimental` to `models.gemini2_5_pro_preview`. Added specific constraints for Gemini Flash/Pro models regarding file writing and end-of-response tags.

eli5.text: The assistant now checks its own work before finishing: after making changes, it runs a verification step and must confirm everything looks correct before wrapping up, rather than just ending the conversation outright. It also switched which AI engine handles different task types, routing standard and high-power jobs to one provider and experimental ones to another, with extra rules to prevent those engines from misplacing files or adding stray text at the end of responses. If you were watching closely, you'd notice the assistant pauses for feedback more often and follows a stricter cleanup routine before signing off.

ai.title: Refine thinking-stream prompt to request code excerpts
ai.summary: Updated `backend/src/thinking-stream.ts` prompt guidelines to request major code change excerpts instead of full line-by-line rewrites. Added explicit instruction to minimize response length and corrected tool call reference examples to first-person. This internal prompt tweak aims to reduce token usage and improve clarity in the thinking stream.

eli5.text: The behind-the-scenes instructions for how the assistant thinks through code changes were refined. Instead of rewriting every line of code step by step while analyzing, it now shows just the key excerpts of the most important changes, using placeholders like "//... existing code..." to skip over unchanged parts. A small tweak like this (just 3 lines added and 3 removed) makes the thinking process clearer and faster for the team that maintains the system.
